Capcom Classics Collection Reloaded.name: Capcom Classics Collection Reloaded
Capcom Classics Collection Reloaded.summary: Capcom Classics Collection Reloaded offers arcade classics which can all be enjoyed alone or via multiplayer using the PSP system's wireless ad hoc mode. Game sharing abilities not only pushes Reloaded over the compilation echelon, but presents the opportunity to be challenged just like the good ole arcade days. For those wanting to experience the games in their original presentation, the screen settings can be changed to suit just that. Relive Capcom's history and savor bonus features by earning credits towards Reloaded's themed slot machine to unlock a buffet of goods including original art, playing tips and secret codes. More than 15 arcade-perfect classics on a single UMD including Eco Fighers, King of Dragons, and Knights of the Round. A wealth of added features including game history, playing tips, original artwork, and new secret codes. Customizable controls to suit any gaming style

Chaos;Head Love Chu Chu!.name: Chaos;Head Love Chu Chu!
Chaos;Head Love Chu Chu!.summary: Chaos;Head Love Chu Chu! is a romantic comedy visual novel developed and produced by 5pb. and Nitroplus. The game is described by the development team as a "exploding delusions ADV" and belongs to the Science Adventure series. Like in Chaos;Head, the player assumes the role of Takumi Nishijo.

Ishin Renka - Ryouma Gaiden.name: Ishin Renka: Ryouma Gaiden
Ishin Renka - Ryouma Gaiden.summary: Ishin Renka: Ryouma Gaiden Shokai Seisanban is a Japanese Otome-style visual novel for the PSP.

LEGO Indiana Jones 2 - The Adventure Con.name: LEGO Indiana Jones 2: The Adventure Continues
LEGO Indiana Jones 2 - The Adventure Con.summary:
LEGO Indy is back in his biggest adventure yet. Battle through all four movies, including all-new levels from the original adventures and your favorite new moments from The Kingdom of the Crystal Skull... or in true LEGO fashion, get creative and build your own levels to play with friends!

New modes including two-player drop-in, drop-out split-screen gameplay lets you play together with your friends and family like never before.

Major League Baseball 2K7.name: Major League Baseball 2K7
Major League Baseball 2K7.summary:
Major League Baseball 2K7 (or MLB 2K7) is a Major League Baseball licensed baseball simulation video game developed by Kush Games and published by 2K Sports. Released on February 27, 2007, it is the only 2007 MLB licensed game available for the Xbox 360 and Xbox. It is also available for the PlayStation Portable, the PlayStation 2 and, for the first time, the PlayStation 3, though its competition came in the form of MLB 07: The Show from 989 Sports. Portable versions for the Nintendo DS, PlayStation Portable, and Game Boy Advance were released. It is the first baseball game to be released for the Nintendo DS and the last major release for the Xbox game console.

For the third year in a row, Derek Jeter is the cover athlete, and ESPN baseball broadcasters Jon Miller and Joe Morgan serve as announcers, despite the loss of the ESPN license to Electronic Arts. Steve Physioc and Jeanne Zelasko cover the pre-game.

Musou Orochi 2 Special.name: Musou Orochi 2 Special
Musou Orochi 2 Special.summary: Musou OROCHI 2 Special is the Japan only PSP port of Warriors Orochi 3. It includes every character and feature from the original game with a few additions.

R-Type Command.name: R-Type Command
R-Type Command.summary: R-Type is reborn! As the war between humans and Bydo rages, the fate of two races will depend upon you. R-Type returns with bold, turn-based strategy gameplay! Build and command a fleet of warships and test your tactical skills against the most dangerous powers in the universe.

Sega Genesis Collection.name: Sega Genesis Collection
Sega Genesis Collection.summary: Sega Genesis Collection features over 30 titles including, Altered Beast, Sonic The Hedgehog, Shinobi III, Phantasy Star, and the original Sega Genesis version of Golden Axe. Sega Genesis Collection also features numerous unlockable items that delve into the soul of the Genesis including interviews with the original developers that created the games featured in the collection, a museum area with interesting facts about the games, a hint area to help gamers complete their favorite Sega Genesis games, and Sega arcade games from the Genesis era.

VitaminR.name: Vitamin R
VitaminR.summary: A PSP game part of the Vitamin series.
